note: Jonathan Gash's Lovejoy novels in publication order, mapped to the TV episodes that adapted them. Bibliography is solid fact (Wikipedia / Fantastic Fiction). The MAPPING is not: the BBC never credited source novels on screen, and neither IMDb nor TMDB records a 'novel' writing credit for any episode. So each mapping carries an explicit status. Promote 'probable' to 'adapted' only when you find a citable source or have read the book and the correspondence is beyond argument.

statuses.adapted: A published source states the episode was based on this novel.
statuses.probable: Strong plot/title correspondence, but no citable source confirms it.

novels.title: The Judas Pair
novels.note: Gash's first Lovejoy novel and the one the series named an episode after. Wikipedia states the episode is based on it.

novels.title: Gold by Gemini
novels.note: Retitled for television. Wikipedia states the episode is based on this novel.

novels.title: The Grail Tree
novels.note: Third of the three novels collected in the Lovejoy at Large Again omnibus. No known episode.

novels.title: Firefly Gadroon
novels.note: The series opener's title is a near-miss on the novel's. Suggestive, but no source confirms the adaptation.

novels.title: The Gondola Scam
novels.note: Venice, forged Old Masters and a conspiracy around fake Renaissance art. The correspondence is strong and The Divvy's own review makes the attribution, but no external source confirms it.
